description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android widget extending TextView that implements logging functionality via the LogNode interface. It formats log messages and displays them within the view.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs formatted log data received through LogNode interface.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats the log data (priority, tag, message, exception) and outputs it to the LogView. Also forwards the log to the next LogNode if set.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append non-null strings to the StringBuilder with a delimiter.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Outputs a string as a new line in the LogView.
